body.title: fix(govern): keep audit event batches within GitLab's limits
body.description:
## Description

`glab govern audit sync` sent audit events in batches of 500, but GitLab limits that endpoint to 5,000 JSON elements, and one event is 13 to 25 or more. Sessions with more than about 200 events to upload failed with `400 Too many total parameters` on every sync, because the cursor doesn't move on failure.

This MR:

- Batches events by JSON element count as well as by number. It counts the way GitLab's `Gitlab::Json::StreamValidator` does, and keeps each request under 4,500 elements. That stays under 5,000 on older self-managed versions too, while https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/merge_requests/263119 raises the GitLab.com limit.
- If GitLab still answers with one of its JSON limit errors, posts each half of the batch separately. An event over a limit on its own can never be accepted, so it's skipped. `glab govern doctor` shows how many were skipped. Any other error keeps the cursor where it is, same as before.
- Removes the repeated "could not post audit events" prefix.
- Waits out GitLab's rate limit on this endpoint (10 requests a minute per user and project). The API client ignores `Retry-After` and gives up after a few seconds, so a session needing more than 10 requests got stuck the same way. The fallback job and manual syncs now wait as GitLab asks, up to 90 seconds at a time, 5 times per request and 20 minutes per run. Hooks still fail fast.

The fake GitLab in the tests now enforces the element limit. The old one only checked the event count, which is why the tests didn't catch this. A unit test pins the element count of a nested event to the 41 that GitLab's validator gives for it.

## Related Issues

Closes https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/work_items/8629

Related to https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/work_items/634442

## How has this been tested?

- `go test ./internal/commands/govern/...`
- Each new sync test fails without the change it covers.
- Compared the element count with `Gitlab::Json::StreamValidator` in GDK.
